items.smallestCoherentRule: The required default request set is fixed by the matrix - every capability whose (capability, mode) cell is SUPPORTED-DESIGN or UNSUPPORTED-TYPED for a discovered unit's mode. A release declaration is an AVAILABILITY statement over that fixed obligation, never a redefinition of it. An absent or unavailable capability is DISCLOSED through the existing unavailable-request route, not dropped. Explicit user configuration overrides the REQUEST and is a recorded choice, not a silent narrowing.
